text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...A fan meeting...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I was asked beforehand to be the committee head.
So I've really gotta fire myself up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to convey our feelings to everyone
who cheers us on...
I'll make sure it's the greatest event ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a joint project with the racetrack,
a fan meeting open to the general public
was decided to be held.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having offered to help out, I ended up
accompanying the committee chair as an assistant, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I can't take it anymore~!
Maybe someone like me just wasn't cut out
to be on the executive committee after all~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!?
Don't say that... What on earth happened?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle and Neo Universe "SLCT"ed
futsal for "communion".
However—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Way too many people signed up, we can't keep up~.
It's clearly over capacity,
and we're getting bombarded with inquiries, it's impossible~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, don't worry!
We'll think of something
to handle it over here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-chan, you're opening a coffee stand,
right? Are you running into any trouble?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing in particular... it's fine...
Just... about the spot... to set up the stand...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's float some tatami mats right on top of the pool!
Swaying footing, soothing sounds of water...
It's got top-tier relaxation perks!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Do tatami mats even float in the first place?
...Nah, that actually sounds fun. Wanna bet
whether you fall in or not before finishing your cup?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
T-That's way too dangerous!
Uh-um, about the stand location—

text_block_list.name: Fan Meeting Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Chair! We just got
a bunch of applications from groups wanting to do
a performance at the fan meeting—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wait a moment!
I'll be right there...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...For the futsal, they should reconsider the venue.
If they consult the coordinator now, it should still be in time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega, who seemed to have been watching
Narita Top Road's desperate struggle,
spoke up to me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Also, she's taking on too much by herself.
At the very least, a separate troubleshooting role
should be assigned to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...With her rushing around so frantically,
it would be stranger not to notice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
Next is the student council room—wait, huh?
Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega remained silent.
...Yet it was clear she was worried and paying close attention. —In that case:
choice_data_list: Ayabe gave us some great advice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eh! Really!?
Wah...! Please, let me hear it too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I-It's not really—
choice_data_list: Let's make this event a success together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ayabe-san is always so dependable!
She notices the smallest details, and besides—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
She's incredibly kind!!
When I got a cut before,
she patched me up right away, and...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't need to list every single thing.
It was nothing...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, geez... fine, I get it.
If it's just behind the scenes, I'll help... so be quiet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eh, are you sure!?
Wah... you really are so kind!
Thank you, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm really happy you're looking out for us.
But please don't overdo it, okay?
If you're busy—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine, really. I can handle backstage work.
Besides... this is for everyone's sake, right?
Where were you planning to go next?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Um, next is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega began briskly divvying up the tasks.
Watching her, I felt confident
the event would be a success.
